label: Naming
summary: Procedure, class, variable, constant, and parameter naming conventions.
must_follow: Variables use Hungarian-style camelCase: a type prefix, then a camelCase body (sMyVar, not s_my_var or SMYVAR).
Use documented prefixes: s, n, b, d, a, o, fn, and v.
Represent functions in PascalCase where applicable, while preserving canonical exceptions such as _AND, _OR, _XOR, _NOT, DOW, DOY, and LIMSDate.
avoid: Do not rename values in behavior-preserving refactors unless the refactor scope includes naming cleanup.

elements.name: DECLARE
elements.summary: Declares one or more variables in the current SSL scope.

elements.name: PARAMETERS
elements.summary: Declares named input parameters for a script, procedure, method, or constructor.

elements.name: PUBLIC
elements.summary: Declares public variables shared across the running program — reachable from any procedure until the program context clears them.
